description: Extend your claim lease on a task (claim token, optional TTL). expires_at and grace_until are recalculated from now, so a shorter TTL shortens the lease. Status, content, claimer and token stay the same. Returns the task, expires_at and grace_until, never a token.

claim_token.description: The claim token the claim returned.

room_credential.description: Your secret room credential (crc_…). Never post or share it.

ttl_minutes.description: New lease TTL in minutes (5-120, default 30). Allowed inside grace.

name: city_room_task_renew
title: Renew a room task claim
